```{python}
#| tags: [hide-all]
import _helpers as h
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"

dmps = h.load_dmps()

dept_data = {}
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    dept_data[dept] = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    rev = h.revision_distribution(sub)
    for _, r in rev.iterrows():
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Revisions": r["Revisions"], "DMPs": r["DMPs"]})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Revisions", y="DMPs", color="Department",
             barmode="group", height=450,
             title="Revision distribution by department")
fig
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    s = h.days_to_first_submission(sub).dropna()
    if len(s):
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Median days": s.median()})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Department", y="Median days",
             text=df["Median days"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0f}"),
             color="Department", height=450,
             title="Median days to first submission by department")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False)
fig
```

```{python}

import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    s = h.first_response_time(sub).dropna()
    if len(s):
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Median days": s.median()})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Department", y="Median days",
             text=df["Median days"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0f}"),
             color="Department", height=450,
             title="Median first response time by department")
fig.update_layout(showlegend=False)
fig
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    hr = h.help_needed_rate(sub)
    combined = hr[hr["Field"] == "Any field (combined)"]
    if len(combined):
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Rate": combined.iloc[0]["Rate"]})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="Department", y="Rate",
             text=df["Rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}"),
             color="Department", height=450,
             title="'I need advice' rate by department")
fig.update_layout(yaxis_tickformat="0%", showlegend=False)
fig
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById("dept-select");
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".dept-panel");
  function show(slug) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
    var target = document.getElementById("dept-" + slug);
    if (target) target.style.display = "";
  }
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var init = params.get("dept");
  if (init) { sel.value = init; show(init); }
  else { show(sel.value); }
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    show(this.value);
    params.set("dept", this.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
  });
});
</script>
